back.es: la pena: penalty, punishment, (prison) sentence; also pity, sorrow, grief, and in Latin America embarrassment
back.example: They gave him a ten-year sentence.

note: La condena also means sentence, but the fixed phrase la pena de muerte points to pena; adding "not condena" to the hint would make that firmer, and the very common sense "vale la pena" (it's worth it) has no card yet.
